app-bar: the list under the bars scrolls; the large title shrinks to a compact one after a few pixels (`compact` prop)
balance-card: the card flips in 3D to a back with the card number, expiry, holder and limit (flip button, or swipe sideways); the hidden face is `inert`
swipe the card sideways to flip it
book-onboarding-flow: swipe the intro left or right to change the page dot
drag the book card; a green ring means Yes, a red ring means No, and the card tilts with the finger
a quick flick of the card counts even when the drag is short
bookshelf-flow: the trending books, the categories and the filter pills pan sideways (mouse drag, touch scroll, coasting)
pull Explore down at the top to refresh (the trending order rotates, a toast says Updated just now)
press and hold a trending book to save it to My Bookmarks (toast)
swipe a shelf card sideways to remove it from the library; Undo brings it back
the search field filters Trending as you type
bottom-sheet: drag the handle or the sheet; it follows the finger and springs back if released early
the sheet slides down and away when dismissed; a Share project button brings it back
swipe the sheet down to dismiss it
a quick flick down dismisses it even when the drag is short
call-flow: press and hold End for 0.9 s to hang up (a white ring fills); a plain tap only shows the hint
press and hold 0 on the keypad to type +
swipe the keypad down to hide it
with the keypad open, a real keyboard types digits, * # +; Backspace deletes, Escape hides
circle-editor: drag a sticker around the circle
two fingers (or ctrl + wheel) resize and rotate the selected sticker
press and hold a sticker to place a copy
drag around the blue ring to scrub the video; Left and Right arrows on the play button step by 5 %
finance-dashboard: a mouse can drag the page to scroll it, as a finger would
pull the page down at the top to refresh (spinner, then a toast)
swipe the tab bar sideways to change tab
swipe the Confirm payment sheet down to close it
floating-action-button: drag the buttons anywhere; they spring back to the dock
flick them left or right to move the dock to the other side
floating-tab-bar: swipe the pill sideways to move to the next or the previous tab
fomo-welcome: tilt the phone and the avatars drift at different depths; a desktop pointer over the phone stands in; iOS gets an Enable tilt button for the permission
let go and it flies off and springs back
grouped-list: swipe a row left to reveal Delete; swipe right to close it
the row slides over the red action; Restore rows brings the deleted rows back
home-screen: swipe the week strip for the next or the previous week, swipe the tab bar to change tab
type in Add a task and press Enter to add a checkbox
housewarming-invite: slide a finger along the RSVP bar to choose Going, Not Going or Maybe (arrow keys work too)
swipe the invitation down (or tap close) to dismiss it; a button reopens it
invoice-detail: a mouse can drag the page to scroll it
pull the page down at the top to refresh
moimoi-sign-in: tilt the phone and the six characters drift at different depths; a desktop pointer stands in; iOS gets an Enable tilt button
let go and it flies off and springs back
music-control-center: a mouse can drag the page to scroll it
pull down at the top to refresh (spinner, toast Обновлено)
swipe a notification row sideways to dismiss it; Вернуть restores them
drag along the listening bars to see the hours at that point
music-profile-banners: a mouse can drag the page to scroll it
pull down at the top to refresh
swipe a notification row sideways to dismiss it
music-profile-compact: a mouse can drag the page to scroll it
pull down at the top to refresh
swipe a notification row sideways to dismiss it
music-profile-tiles: a mouse can drag the page to scroll it
pull down at the top to refresh
swipe a notification row sideways to dismiss it
press and hold an achievement for its caption
nexus-courses: swipe the screen left or right to go to the next or the previous tab
pull down to refresh (spinner, toast Up to date)
press and hold a course card to save it (blue ring, Saved chip)
nexus-daily-activity: swipe the week strip to move the selected day
press and hold a challenge card to join it (the chip says Joined)
nexus-home: swipe the screen left or right to change tab; swipe the week strip to move the selected day
pull down to refresh (spinner, toast Up to date)
nexus-today: swipe the screen left or right to change tab; swipe the week strip to move the selected day
press and hold a challenge card to join it
nft-auction-flow: swipe a live card right to like it, left to unlike it
pull Live Bids down to refresh (spinner, new current bid, toast)
two fingers (or ctrl + wheel) zoom the item picture; it eases back when released
the item page scrolls and the sticky actions appear
swipe the Place a bid sheet down to close it
drag along the bar to set the bid amount (arrow keys step by 0.05 ETH)
press and hold Confirm for 0.8 s to place the bid; a tap only shows the hint
press and hold a bid row to copy its details (toast)
nft-search-results: pan the collections row sideways (eight collections, the chevron scrolls it)
flick or swipe a card to throw it to the front or the back
the search field is a real input
orb-profile: tilt the phone and the photo and the three badges drift at different depths; a desktop pointer stands in; iOS gets an Enable tilt button
swipe the screen down (or tap close) to dismiss it; a button reopens it
press and hold the avatar to enlarge it; tap to close
premium-paywall: swipe the plan sheet left for Monthly, right for Annual
restoring-purchases: swipe the screen to the right to go back to the paywall
sticker-picker: swipe the sheet down to close it; swipe it sideways to change the pack
press and hold a sticker to peek at it full size; let go to dismiss
story-rings: press and hold a story to mark it as new again; a tap marks it seen
task-list: type in Add a task and press Enter to add a checkbox
tracking-steps: drag along the steps to move the shipment forward or back (Left and Right arrow keys too)
voice-rooms-flow: swipe any screen down to go back; swipe Home left for the Universe; swipe a feed row sideways to hide it
pull Home down to refresh (spinner, the viewer counts grow)
press and hold the hand in a room for 0.7 s to raise it (toast)
press and hold a chat message to react with a thumbs up
wabi-welcome: tilt the phone and the spheres drift at different depths; a desktop pointer stands in; iOS gets an Enable tilt button
let go and it flies off and springs back
two fingers (or ctrl + wheel) zoom the whole field; it eases back when released
week-strip: swipe the strip sideways for the next or the previous week (the dates change)
the days slide with the finger
liquid-glass-chat: drag the Your circle ribbon vertically to open or close it (it snaps)
open chats, compose, attach, send, zoom the photo
the composer and the search field are real inputs
